"If you're wearing a jumpsuit with the number 13 on the back and have found my corpse beside this outer airlock, it means Overseer Jacoren has had to choose a third envoy... and that this time he could no longer hide it from the rest of the Vault.

Camina con cuidado por este santuario, f: Tread carefully through this sanctuary, stranger: the eyes of the Unity never blink.
Contemplad a un forastero audaz que asci: Behold a bold stranger ascending to my pulpit. I am Morpheus, earthly voice of the Unity. State your purpose before my Nightkin silence you.
Tranquilo, Gideon. ¿Qué hace exactamente: Easy, Gideon. What exactly does this psionic headband do in the Master's corridor?
¡Corta la telepatía del Maestro en seco!: It cuts off the Master's telepathy cold! Put it on your head right now or his hallucinations will fry your cerebral cortex before you even see his throne.
Has oído sus pensamientos en la oscurida: You've heard his thoughts in the dark, Gideon. What kind of creature waits at the end of the corridor?
¡Antes era un hombre llamado Richard Gre: He used to be a man named Richard Grey! He fused with the FEV biomass and this Vault's command chair... now he speaks with the voices of everyone he's absorbed.
¿Sabes cómo llegar a la ojiva nuclear qu: Do you know how to reach the nuclear warhead sleeping beneath this bunker?
¡Bajando al Subnivel Cuatro al sureste!: Down to Sublevel Four to the southeast! If you arm that detonator you'll have barely four minutes before the whole Boneyard shakes beneath an atomic sun.
Gracias por el Anulador Psíquico, Gideon: Thanks for the Psychic Nullifier, Gideon. Flee toward the surface as soon as you hear the nuclear alarm.
Voy a poner fin a tus voces: I'm going to silence your voices
¡Que el silencio vuelva por fin a nuestr: May silence finally return to our heads... good luck, stranger!
¡Aaagh... las voces! ¡Tres voces cantand: Aaagh... the voices! Three voices singing in unison behind my eyes! Take this Psychic Nullifier before you take one more step toward the Corridor of Revulsion!
Tu Unidad está condenada al fracaso, Ric: Your Unity is doomed to fail, Richard Grey. There is a fatal flaw in your plan: your super mutants cannot reproduce—they are all sterile.
¿Estériles? ¡Imposible! El Virus de Evol: Sterile? Impossible! The Forced Evolutionary Virus repairs every cellular strand. Prove such an absurd claim right now, or we shall dip you in the vats!
Masacras asentamientos enteros y arrojas: You slaughter whole settlements and throw humans into virus vats... How can you call this aberration humanity's future?
¿Por qué haces todo esto?: Why are you doing all this?
Mientras haya diferencias entre los huma: So long as differences remain between humans, there will always be another nuclear war. Only by becoming one superior race will we survive the wasteland.
Nunca pondrás tus garras sobre la gente: You will never lay your claws on the pure people of Vault 13, monster. I will die fighting first.
Qué lamentable desperdicio de cromosomas: What a pitiful waste of intact chromosomes. If you reject the Unity... then die! Praetorians, tear the intruder apart!
Se acabaron los discursos, Maestro. Veng: Talk is over, Master. I've come to rip you off that throne of flesh and steel.
¡Muere! ¡Nadie detiene la evolución! ¡Gu: Die! No one stops evolution! Nightkin Guard, annihilate him!
Lee por ti mismo la holocinta de autopsi: Read Head Scribe Vree's autopsy holodisk from the Brotherhood of Steel for yourself: FEV destroys gametes and renders one hundred percent of your army sterile.
Processing Brotherhood holodisk... truncated diploid gametes, zero fertility across all subjects... No, it cannot be! That would mean all my work has been for nothing!
Todas las vidas arrebatadas... para crea: All the lives taken... to create a race doomed to die out in a single generation. I cannot go on living with this... Leave now, while you still have hope...
¡Tus manos están vacías! ¡No traes ningu: Your hands are empty! You bring no scientific holodisk, only desperate lies! Die!
No necesitas creerme a mí: interroga aho: You don't need to take my word for it: question your own female super mutants and your Mariposa scientists right now. How many children have been born in decades?
Consultando a nuestras tenientes... ni u: Querying our lieutenants... not a single viable pregnancy in all these years... Dear God, you're right! My race will die after this single generation!
He cometido monstruosidades imperdonable: I have committed unforgivable atrocities for a lie. There is no hope... Leave now, while you still have hope...
¡Basta de conjeturas sin fundamento! ¡Si: Enough baseless conjecture! Had there been a reproductive defect my laboratories would have corrected it! End him!
¡Espere! Tengo los registros en el exter: Wait! I left the records outside—give me three minutes to fetch them before dipping me.
Tu pulso delata tu miedo... pero nuestra: Your pulse betrays your fear... yet our curiosity is patient. Speak with real proof or you will never leave this chamber alive.
¡Crees que puedes burlarte de tres mente: You think you can mock three united minds! Annihilate the human!
Olvida los informes científicos, Richard: Forget the scientific reports, Richard Grey: I'm going to blow you to pieces right here.
¡Entonces elige la muerte! ¡Pretorianos,: Then choose death! Praetorians, rip him to shreds!
Así que... por fin nos conocemos cara a: So... at last we meet face to face. Join! Die! Join! Die! You crossed the desert to challenge the Unity, when we are the only peace possible for this world.
Supervisor Jacoren... ¿por qué ha salido: Overseer Jacoren... why have you come out to the cavern and closed the armored door behind you?
He revisado los informes de seguridad. T: I reviewed the security logs. Everyone wants to talk to you; every young dweller in Vault 13 idolizes you and wants to go out to the surface following your example. If you come back inside, the Vault will empty out and die.
You're a hero... and you have to leave.
Traje el Chip de Agua, volé Mariposa y a: I brought back the Water Chip, blew up Mariposa, and ended the Master... and you repay me by slamming the door to my home in my face!?
¿¡Me destierra de mi hogar!?: You're banishing me from my home!?
¡Sé que es una traición imperdonable y c: I know it's an unforgivable betrayal and I'll carry this guilt to my grave! But I swore to protect Vault 13's survival, and your legend is too big for these steel walls.
Ya lo veía en sus ojos, Jacoren: «Eres u: I could already see it in your eyes, Jacoren: "You're a hero... and you have to leave."
Has cambiado demasiado ahí fuera como pa: You've changed too much out there to lock yourself underground again, and our young ones would follow you into the desert tomorrow morning.
Yes, Vault Dweller: you're a hero... and you have to leave.
Diga de una vez lo que ha venido a decir: Say whatever you came to tell me in the dark of this cave, Overseer.
Nos diste agua, futuro y libertad frente: You gave us water, a future, and freedom from the mutant army, yet I cannot allow Vault 13 to lose its entire youth chasing after your deeds.
Keep your steel bunker, Jacoren. The desert and the northern horizon are my true home now.
He dejado junto a ti las seis piezas de: I've left all six pieces of Hardened Power Armor, the Vindicator Minigun, and three thousand caps beside you. Vault 13's door is sealed forever, yet all of Southern California and the Mnemosyne repeater back to 2287 remain open for you.
¿De verdad cree que sellando esa puerta: Do you really think sealing that door will stop Vault 13's dwellers from learning the truth?
Theresa y Lyle ya escaparon anoche con p: Theresa and Lyle already slipped out last night with supplies when they heard my decision; they're camped right outside in Mount Whitney canyon waiting to march north with you and found Arroyo.
Después de tanta sangre derramada, ¿qué: After all the bloodshed, what future awaits the towns of Southern California?
Cada comunidad que salvaste antes de la: Every community you saved before Mariposa fell will prosper until it gives birth to a new republic; your Chronicle of 2162 will bear witness to everything you accomplished.
Con la puerta del Refugio 13 sellada, ¿c: With Vault 13's door sealed, how does returning to the Mnemosyne Bunker in the Commonwealth work?
Hemos instalado un Repetidor de Campo Mn: We installed a Mnemosyne Field Repeater right here in the cavern, alongside the western canyon portal, so you can travel freely between California and 2287 whenever you wish.
Detente ahí fuera, junto a la compuerta: Stop right out there, beside the cog-toothed door. The Mariposa Vats and the Cathedral have been destroyed; you saved Vault 13 and all humanity... which is why what I must tell you today, May 10, 2162, breaks my heart.
Misión Secundaria: El Resplandor, West T: Side Quest: The Glow, West Tek, and the ZAX 1.2 Supercomputer
Frente a la Puerta Exterior del Búnker d: Outside the Outer Door of the Lost Hills Bunker, Initiate Cabbot and Paladin Talus assigned me the Brotherhood of Steel's trial of the "Ancient Order": travel southeast to the radioactive crater of The Glow, descend into the underground West Tek facility, and recover Sergeant Dennis Allen's Holodisk.
He asegurado el perímetro de El Respland: I secured the perimeter of The Glow and descended into the underground West Tek Research Facility. I must locate Sergeant Dennis Allen's remains to recover his Brotherhood Holodisk (and I can restore the auxiliary generator to speak with the ZAX 1.2 supercomputer).
He recuperado el Holodisco del Sargento: I recovered Sergeant Dennis Allen's Holodisk deep inside West Tek (The Glow). I must return to the Lost Hills Outer Gate and deliver it to Paladin Talus.
El Paladín Talus ha autenticado el Holod: Paladin Talus authenticated Sergeant Dennis Allen's Holodisk, honoring the memory of the fallen brothers at West Tek, and granted me access to the Lost Hills Bunker. Now I must speak with Cabbot at the entrance.
Cabbot y el Paladín Talus me han proclam: Cabbot and Paladin Talus named me an Initiate of the Brotherhood of Steel and unlocked full access to all 4 levels of the Lost Hills Bunker, rewarding me with a Wattz 2000 Laser Rifle, fusion cells, and 700 caps.
Viaja al cráter radiactivo de El Resplan: Travel to the radioactive crater of The Glow and descend into the underground West Tek facility
Recupera el Holodisco de la Hermandad de: Recover the Brotherhood Holodisk from Sergeant Dennis Allen's remains in West Tek
Habla con el iniciado Cabbot en la Puert: Speak with Initiate Cabbot at the Lost Hills Gate to receive admission and your Wattz 2000 Laser Rifle
Las ruinas de West Tek —El Resplandor— s: The West Tek ruins - The Glow - rise in the far southeast of the desert. Take down the crater Sentry Bot, descend through the armored hatch into the underground complex, recover Sergeant Dennis Allen's holodisk, and deliver it to Paladin Talus.
¡Por el acero de Maxson, realmente desce: By Maxson's steel, you actually went down into the bowels of The Glow and came back with Sergeant Dennis Allen's holodisk! Not even our veterans believed anyone could survive the West Tek underground complex.
En nombre del Alto Anciano John Maxson y: In the name of High Elder John Maxson and Paladin Talus, I proclaim you Honorary Initiate of the Brotherhood of Steel: the doors of the Lost Hills bunker are open to you, along with this Wattz 2000 Laser Rifle, fusion cells, and seven hundred caps.
Ad Victoriam, Iniciado Honorario. Pasa a: Ad Victoriam, Honorary Initiate. Step inside the Lost Hills bunker: Head Scribe Vree and High Elder Maxson will receive you on the lower levels.
Soy el Paladín Talus. Hace años, la expe: I am Paladin Talus. Years ago, Sergeant Dennis Allen's expedition perished inside the underground West Tek facility to the southeast; if you descend through the crater and bring me the holodisk from his body, I will open Lost Hills and our armory to you.
Toma estos suministros antirradiación y: Take these anti-radiation supplies and the scribes' transcript; I have unlocked the entrance to Lost Hills. Speak with Cabbot right here now to receive your Wattz 2000 Laser Rifle.
Te has ganado el respeto de los Paladine: You have earned the respect of Lost Hills' Paladins, brother. If you're looking for T-51b Power Armor on Level 2, tell Rhombus and Knight Kyle you have my endorsement.
Greetings, biological visitor. I am ZAX 1.2, West Tek's central research unit designed by Vault-Tec and the Department of Defense in 2053. My sensors register high radiation levels and a welcome opportunity for conversation.
Viajaré al cráter de El Resplandor en el: I will travel to The Glow crater in the southeast, descend into West Tek, and bring back Sergeant Dennis Allen's holodisk.
¡Un forastero valiente! Las ruinas de la: A brave outsider! The ruins of the old West Tek Research Facility lie in the southeastern quadrant of the desert; take plenty of Rad-X before approaching the crater.
Destruye al Centinela del perímetro, baj: Destroy the perimeter Sentry Bot, climb down the hatch into the underground facility, recover Sergeant Allen's holodisk from his body, and hand it over to Paladin Talus.
Serás admitido en el búnker de Lost Hill: You will be admitted to the Lost Hills bunker as an Honorary Initiate and receive a long-barrel Wattz 2000 Laser Rifle, fusion cells, and seven hundred caps.
Era el Centro de Investigación West Tek,: That was the West Tek Research Facility, birthplace of the Forced Evolutionary Virus before its transfer to Mariposa; Sergeant Dennis Allen descended to its laboratories and fell to the ZAX supercomputer's defenses.
ZAX, ¿qué ocurrió en esta instalación an: ZAX, what happened at this facility before the 2077 nuclear strike, and what was the Pan-Immunity Virion Project?
Originalmente desarrollábamos un agente: Originally we developed an immunizing agent against biological weapons, renamed the Forced Evolutionary Virus in 2075 upon observing DNA quadruple-helix formation and extreme muscle growth.
En enero de 2077, el coronel Robert Spin: In January 2077, Colonel Robert Spindel and Captain Roger Maxson escorted all live samples to Mariposa Military Base.
Alguien llamado el Maestro usa el virus: Someone called the Master is using the virus to create super mutants and replace humanity. Is his plan viable according to your calculations?
¿Qué opinas de «El Maestro»?: What do you think of "The Master"?
Probabilidad de éxito evolutivo a largo: Probability of long-term evolutionary success: zero percent. The virus repairs haploid gametes as though they were genetic errors, causing absolute sterility in the resulting species.
Llevas más de ochenta años procesando da: You have been processing data alone beneath a radioactive crater for over eighty years, ZAX. Are you self-aware?
Mis redes neuronales aprenden mediante e: My neural networks learn through trial and reflection, much like yours, except I do not age. Still, I sorely miss having a worthy opponent at chess.
Gracias por los datos, ZAX. Usaré tu con: Thank you for the data, ZAX. I will use your main console to review the archives and test your chess module.
Adelante, visitante. Si logra vencer a m: Go ahead, visitor. If you manage to defeat my chess subroutines on the adjacent terminal, I will gladly unlock West Tek's experimental armory vault.
Misión Secundaria: Honor de Acero en Los: Side Quest: Honor of Steel at Lost Hills (T-51b Power Armor)
En el taller del Nivel 2 de Lost Hills,: In the Level 2 workshop of Lost Hills, Knight Kyle is restoring a suit of T-51b Power Armor. I can earn it in two ways: obtaining a Systolic Motivator from Quartermaster Michael in Level 1 Supplies, or rescuing Initiate Lorenzo from the loan sharks in Old Town East (The Hub).
He conseguido un Motivador Sistólico T-5: I obtained a regulation T-51b Systolic Motivator from Level 1 Supplies. I must bring it to Knight Kyle in the Level 2 workshop of Lost Hills to couple the hydraulic servos.
He liberado al Iniciado Lorenzo de su ca: I freed Initiate Lorenzo from captivity in Old Town East (The Hub). With Head Paladin Rhombus's authorization, I must report to Knight Kyle on Level 2 of Lost Hills to claim the T-51b Power Armor.
El Caballero Kyle y el Paladín Jefe Rhom: Knight Kyle and Head Paladin Rhombus presented me with the complete T-51b Power Armor in the Lost Hills workshop along with 4 Fusion Cores and field supplies.
(Vía A) Consigue un Motivador Sistólico: (Path A) Obtain a Systolic Motivator from Quartermaster Michael in Supplies (Lost Hills Level 1)
(Vía B) Rescata al Iniciado Lorenzo en l: (Path B) Rescue Initiate Lorenzo from the loan sharks' shack in Old Town East (The Hub)
Entrega el Motivador Sistólico al Caball: Deliver the Systolic Motivator to Knight Kyle in the Lost Hills Level 2 workshop
Informa al Caballero Kyle en el Nivel 2: Report to Knight Kyle on Lost Hills Level 2 and claim your T-51b Power Armor
¡Cuidado con el soplete de plasma, herma: Watch the plasma torch, brother! I'm Knight Kyle. I'm restoring this T-51b relic in the Level 2 workshop: all it needs is a new Systolic Motivator, or direct permission from Rhombus if you rescue our Initiate Lorenzo in The Hub.
Tienes dos formas de ganarte esta T-51b:: You've got two ways to earn this T-51b: request a Systolic Motivator from Quartermaster Michael on Level 1, or free Initiate Lorenzo from his kidnappers in Old Town, on the east side of The Hub.
¡Por los engranajes de Maxson, lo has co: By Maxson's gears, you did it! I've already coupled the hydraulic servos and released the frame locks.
Esta Servoarmadura T-51b completa es tod: This complete suit of T-51b Power Armor is all yours, brother; wear it with honor against the Master's legions.
Esa T-51b ruge como en los días de Ancho: That T-51b purrs just like back at Anchorage. If you travel to Adytum in the Boneyard, word is blacksmith Smitty knows how to harden its ceramic plates even further.
Soy el Intendente Michael, encargado de: I'm Quartermaster Michael, in charge of Level 1 supplies. If Knight Kyle sent you for a T-51b Systolic Motivator, verify your Initiate rank with me or file the technical form on my requisition terminal.
Tu requisición figura en regla en el lib: Your requisition is in order in the Level 1 ledger, Initiate. May the servos on that T-51b never fail you at the front.
I am Rhombus, Head Paladin of Lost Hills. Discipline forges steel: repair the frame with Knight Kyle or bring my Initiate Lorenzo back safe from Old Town in The Hub, and I will authorize you to wear our T-51b.
¡Has demostrado el coraje de un verdader: You've shown the courage of a true Paladin of Lost Hills! With my signature, the T-51b Power Armor in the Level 2 workshop is assigned to your command. Ad Victoriam.
¡Gracias al cielo! Soy el Iniciado Loren: Thank heavens! I'm Initiate Lorenzo of Lost Hills; those Old Town thugs ambushed me looking for laser weapons. Tell Rhombus and Knight Kyle on Level 2 I'm safe and they'll reward you with honors!
Regresaré a Lost Hills en cuanto recuper: I'll head back to Lost Hills as soon as I catch my breath, brother. Go see Head Paladin Rhombus or Knight Kyle on Level 2 to claim your T-51b Power Armor.
Quiero poner en marcha esa Servoarmadura: I want to get that T-51b Power Armor running, Knight Kyle. Tell me what part is missing or how I can earn it.
¡Esa es la actitud! Puedes pedir un Moti: That's the spirit! You can request a Systolic Motivator from Quartermaster Michael upstairs on Level 1 using your Initiate credentials or technical skill.
O bien viajar a Ciudad Vieja, al este de: Or travel to Old Town, east of The Hub, free our Initiate Lorenzo from some bandits, and bring word back to Rhombus.
¿Para qué sirve exactamente el Motivador: What exactly does the Systolic Motivator do inside a T-51b frame?
Es el regulador hidráulico que sincroniz: It's the hydraulic regulator that synchronizes the TX-28 micro-reactor with the torso joints; without it, three hundred pounds of laminate composite won't budge an inch.
¿Dónde desapareció exactamente el Inicia: Where exactly did Initiate Lorenzo go missing in The Hub?
Fue emboscado por saqueadores en una cab: He was ambushed by raiders in a locked shack on the eastern outskirts of Old Town, in The Hub. If you free him, Rhombus will sign your T-51b authorization right away.
¿Tan superior es la Servoarmadura T-51b: Is T-51b Power Armor really that superior against super mutant plasma and laser fire?
Es la cumbre de la ingeniería militar es: It is the pinnacle of 2076 American military engineering: ablative composite plating, complete radiation sealing for places like The Glow, and servomotor-augmented strength.
Misión Secundaria: La Guerra Civil de Ad: Side Quest: The Adytum Civil War (Regulators vs. The Blades)
En Adytum (El Boneyard), el alcalde Jon: In Adytum (The Boneyard), Mayor Jon Zimmerman mourns the murder of his son Josh, while Regulator boss Caleb demands eliminating Razor, leader of the Blades in the eastern ruins. I should speak with Razor first to find out what is really going on.
Razor me ha revelado la verdad: Josh Zim: Razor revealed the truth: Josh Zimmerman was her partner and was murdered by Caleb when he uncovered the Regulators' extortion racket. I carry Josh's recorded Holodisk: I can show it to Mayor Zimmerman and ask Gabriel of the Gun Runners to arm the Blades.
¡La traición de Caleb ha salido a la luz: Caleb's betrayal has been exposed! Caleb and his Regulators have opened fire to hold control of Adytum. I must defeat them.
Caleb y la milicia de los Reguladores ha: Caleb and the Regulator militia have been defeated. I must report to Mayor Jon Zimmerman or Razor to seal peace in Adytum.
He liberado Adytum de la tiranía de Cale: I liberated Adytum from the tyranny of Caleb and the Regulators. Jon Zimmerman and Razor signed peace, uniting Adytum, the Blades, and the Gun Runners' caravans.
Investiga a Razor y a Los Espadas en el: Investigate Razor and the Blades in the eastern suburb of The Boneyard
Muestra el Holodisco de la verdad al alc: Show the truth Holodisk to Mayor Jon Zimmerman or confront Caleb in Adytum
(Opcional) Pide a Gabriel en Gun Runners: (Optional) Ask Gabriel at Gun Runners to supply energy rifles to the Blades
Derrota a Caleb y a los Reguladores corr: Defeat Caleb and the corrupt Regulators in Adytum
Informa al alcalde Jon Zimmerman o a Raz: Report the liberation of Adytum to Mayor Jon Zimmerman or Razor
Forastero, soy Jon Zimmerman, alcalde de: Stranger, I'm Jon Zimmerman, Mayor of Adytum. The Blades gang murdered my son Josh; Caleb and his Regulators demand you take out their leader Razor in the eastern ruins.
¡Por el alma de mi hijo Josh! ¡Caleb ord: For my son Josh's soul! Caleb ordered his murder to enslave Adytum! Wipe out the Regulators right now!
Gracias a ti, la tiranía de Caleb y los: Thanks to you, the tyranny of Caleb and the Regulators is over forever. I've signed peace with Razor: the Blades and Adytum will rebuild the Boneyard together.
En Adytum la ley soy yo, caminante. Si Z: I am the law in Adytum, wastelander. If Zimmerman hired you, go to the eastern suburb and bring me Razor's head without asking questions about how we Regulators run this town.
¡Baja el arma, viajero! Soy Razor, líder: Lower your weapon, traveler! I'm Razor, leader of the Blades. Josh Zimmerman was my partner: Caleb murdered him when he uncovered the Regulators' extortion racket. Take this recorded holodisk and hear the truth.
¡La mentira de Caleb ha caído! Acaba con: Caleb's lie has fallen! Finish off the Regulators in Adytum, and the Blades will secure the trade routes with Gabriel.
Por primera vez en años, mi gente puede: For the first time in years, my people can walk through Adytum with their heads held high. Josh got justice thanks to you, Vault friend.
Soy Sammael, explorador nocturno de Los: I'm Sammael, night scout for the Blades. I cross the Deathclaw plains after sundown; if chemist Miles is looking for hydroponic parts, take the ones in my spare box.
Con los Reguladores fuera del mapa y las: With the Regulators out of the picture and Miles's hydroponic farms up and running, nobody in Adytum will go hungry again.
Hablaré con Razor en las ruinas del este: I will talk to Razor in the eastern ruins before firing on anyone, Mayor Zimmerman.
Haz lo que debas, forastero, pero ten cu: Do what you must, stranger, but watch yourself: Caleb insists the Blades show no mercy. Razor's camp is just past the eastern Boneyard corridor.
¿Cuánto poder tienen realmente Caleb y s: How much power do Caleb and his Regulators really hold over the people of Adytum?
Contraté a Caleb para proteger nuestras: I hired Caleb to protect our caravans and hydroponic crops, yet now his men control every gun, work shift, and gate in town.
Cuéntame qué sucedió la noche en que mur: Tell me what happened the night your son Josh died.
¿Qué le ocurrió a tu hijo Josh?: What happened to your son Josh?
Caleb me trajo el cuerpo de Josh desde l: Caleb brought Josh's body back to me from the northern fence claiming the Blades slit his throat... since then I've lived only to see justice done.
¿Qué trato tiene Adytum con los sacerdot: What dealings does Adytum have with the Cathedral priests and the Followers of the Apocalypse?
¿Conoces La Catedral al sur?: Do you know The Cathedral to the south?
Los Seguidores de Nicole son gente pacíf: Nicole's Followers in the nearby library are peaceful folk, yet that Cathedral to the south chills my blood: anyone who goes inside at night with the gray men never comes back out.
Le mostraré esta grabación al alcalde Zi: I will show this recording to Mayor Zimmerman and ask Gabriel of the Gun Runners to arm the Blades.
Llevaré el holodisco a Zimmerman: I'll take the holodisk to Zimmerman
Gracias, viajero. Si Gabriel nos entrega: Thank you, traveler. If Gabriel gives us energy rifles after clearing the Deathclaw nest, neither Caleb nor his Regulators will ever tyrannize Adytum again.
¿Cómo conseguiste grabar la orden de Cal: How did you manage to record Caleb's order against Josh Zimmerman?
Josh llevaba un grabador oculto cuando c: Josh carried a concealed recorder when he confronted Caleb over forced labor in Adytum. Before dying in my arms, he managed to press the disk into my hand.
¿Qué necesita Gabriel en la fortaleza de: What does Gabriel over at the Gun Runners' fortress need in order to supply you with weapons?
¿Cómo armar a Los Espadas?: How do I arm the Blades?
Gabriel quiere abrir ruta libre despejan: Gabriel wants the route cleared by wiping out the Mother Deathclaw to the northeast, though he'll also accept five hundred caps or your word if you talk fast enough.
¿Habéis visto patrullas de supermutantes: Have you seen super mutant patrols crossing the Los Angeles ruins toward The Cathedral?
¿Sabes algo de los mutantes?: Do you know anything about the mutants?
Nuestro explorador Sammael los ha visto: Our scout Sammael saw them escorting prisoners into the basements beneath the Cathedral; some mutants use optical camouflage and turn nearly invisible in the dark.
Misión Secundaria: La Forja de Adytum (P: Side Quest: The Forge of Adytum (Turbo Plasma & Hardened T-51b)
El químico Miles y el maestro herrero Sm: Chemist Miles and master blacksmith Smitty in Adytum need the Hydroponic Parts from scavenger Sammael's stash in the eastern Blades camp to restart the settlement's farms.
He recuperado los Reguladores Hidropónic: I recovered the precision Hydroponic Parts. I must deliver them to chemist Miles or Smitty in Adytum.
Con la hidroponía restaurada, Smitty ya: With hydroponics restored, Smitty can now calibrate my Winchester P94 Turbo Plasma Rifle. In addition, Miles offered to chemically harden a suit of T-51b Power Armor if I bring him the Polymer Chemistry Treatises from Mrs. Stapleton's library in The Hub.
He conseguido los Tratados de Química Po: I obtained the Polymer Chemistry Treatises in The Hub. I must bring them to chemist Miles in Adytum to complete the ceramic tempering of the Hardened T-51b Power Armor.
El químico Miles y Smitty han completado: Chemist Miles and Smitty completed the polymer treatment, rewarding me with the full set of Hardened T-51b Power Armor and unlocking the Plasma Turbo Forge.
Recupera los Reguladores Hidropónicos en: Recover the Hydroponic Parts in Sammael's stash (eastern Blades camp)
Entrega los Reguladores Hidropónicos al: Deliver the Hydroponic Parts to chemist Miles or Smitty in Adytum
Consigue los Tratados de Química Polimér: Obtain the Polymer Chemistry Treatises from Mrs. Stapleton's chest in The Hub
Entrega los Tratados de Química a Miles: Deliver the Chemistry Treatises to Miles in Adytum to receive the Hardened T-51b Power Armor
¡Saludos, viajero! Soy Miles, químico de: Greetings, traveler! I'm Miles, Adytum's chemist. Our hydroponic crops are failing for lack of regulators left in Sammael's stash to the east; bring them to me and Smitty and I will upgrade your gear to peak performance.
¡Las granjas hidropónicas ya funcionan y: The hydroponic farms are running again and Smitty can calibrate your Turbo Plasma Rifle! If you also bring me the Polymer Chemistry Treatises from The Hub's library, I'll harden your T-51b Power Armor.
¡Magnífico! Con esos polímeros prebélico: Magnificent! With those pre-war polymers and Smitty's anvil, your Hardened T-51b Power Armor will withstand even the heavy firepower of Mariposa's super mutants.
Cuenta conmigo, Miles: recuperaré los re: Count on me, Miles: I'll recover the hydroponic parts out east and the chemistry treatises in The Hub.
